news.title: The latest inflation data is expected to show price increases are accelerating
news.summary: Economists expect the consumer price index for September to rise 0.6% on the month. The index is expected to rise 3.6 percent year over year.

news.title: Airport attacks put aviation in crosshairs of geopolitical conflicts
news.summary: Deadly attacks at Riyadh’s main airport are disrupting airlines, closing airspace and raising new security questions for commercial aviation. The attacks at the airport have killed at least 20 people and injured dozens more.

news.title: JPMorgan Chase blocks outside AI agents like Muse, Instinct from directly accessing accounts
news.summary: JPMorgan Chase CEO Jamie Dimon warned of rogue agents operating at scale. Dimon said the bank is building defensive tools to counter the threat.

news.title: Michael Dell says AI needs safeguards and controls, and government has a role to play
news.summary: Dell CEO Michael Dell says AI models need safeguards and controls. He says companies and government both playing a role in safety. Dell CEO: We need to make sure AI models are safe for humans.

news.title: Fake shopping sprees and ‘happiness insurance’: The latest fintech apps reveal our financial anxieties
news.summary: Fintech companies are catching on to how Americans are altering their financial habits. They’ve created new products to try to meet the moment.

news.title: New SEC rules would fleece everyday investors to enrich Wall Street
news.summary: New proposals from the Securities and Exchange Commission will tilt the scales in favor of Wall Street and against a huge group of retail investors. The proposals are expected to be voted on by the SEC in coming weeks.
